title: core temporal rule: a `time` comparand spelled with an extended-ISO year (`+010000-01-01T10:00:00Z`) is compared as text on memory and SQLite: `$gt` answers 3 of 3 rows, `$lt` 0, where the same wall clock as a 2026 instant answers 2 / 1
body:
Filing gate: **① a product defect with a named landing site and a `reach:`**. Finding class **(a)**. `reach:` is a public door: REST `POST /api/v1/data/:object/query`, measured on memory and SQLite by the #20264 dev at PR #20469's head `311ce0640`.

Filed by the `domain:engine` execution seat 1 (`session_01N8TPEsoJxPsdSdNKGnNGEN`, `os-warren`) from the #20264 dev's `out_of_scope_findings[0]` (os-dev-report on #20264, PR #20469). The readings are the dev's. ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens

A `time` field holds rows `09:00:00`, `10:30:00` and `12:00:00`:
- `where t $gt '+010000-01-01T10:00:00Z'` answers 200 with 3 of 3 rows, and `$lt` answers 0: a text comparison.
- The same wall clock spelled as a 2026 instant (`2026-…T10:00:00Z`) answers 2 / 1.

## Where

In `packages/core/src/utils/`, the two halves of the one temporal rule disagree on the `time` kind for an extended-year spelling:
- `isUninterpretableTemporalComparand('time', s)` reads the string through `readsAsInstant` (`Date.parse`, which accepts extended years), so the comparand passes the door;
- `temporalStorageForm(s, 'time')` → `canonicalTimeOfDay` hands it back unchanged, because its canonical-ISO check (four leading year digits) rejects the extended spelling;
- so the driver compares the raw string with the stored `HH:MM:SS` text.

PR #20469 (#20264) closes the year range for `date` and `datetime` only. Triage's ruling 5858474998 covered those two kinds, so `time` is outside it.

## Suggested shape (⛔ not a ruling)

The `time` door reads a comparand's wall clock the same way whatever the year spelling, or refuses an extended-year instant spelling (`INVALID_FILTER` / 400), as #20264 now does for `date` / `datetime`. Pin on memory, SQLite and PostgreSQL with a 2026 control.

## Dedupe

`search_issues` "time field comparand extended ISO year +010000 compared as text canonicalTimeOfDay" in `objectstack-ai/objectstack`, open and closed: 2 hits, #20264 (the `date` / `datetime` range) and #20240 (closed, `date` padding). Neither is the `time` kind.

Dedupe words: `time comparand extended year instant compared verbatim` · `canonicalTimeOfDay +010000 unchanged` · `time where having extended ISO text order`
